tasks.title: The Cleansing Of Qeynos Hills: Part 1
tasks.description: [1,Slay ten rats in Qeynos Hills.][2,Return to Guard Philbin.]

tasks.title: The Cleansing Of Qeynos Hills: Part 2
tasks.description: Kill 5 Bats

tasks.title: The Cleansing Of Qeynos Hills: Part 3
tasks.description: Kill 2 Snakes

tasks.title: The Cleansing Of Qeynos Hills: The Final Task

tasks.title: Extraordinary Rodents
tasks.description: [1,2, Go to the Misty Thicket, kill 10 giant thicket rats and loot four rat whiskers.][3, Excellent work! Return to Ace Slighthand to tell him of your work.][4, Now deliver the rat whiskers to Swish Appletop in the Misty Thicket.]

tasks.title: They're a Bit Short
tasks.description: [1, They might as well call you a scout, because you'll be going out and doing some scouting on some very high-profile sites. These sites are rumored to be burial grounds for priests of an ancient civilization, but there is not much information on them than that. Enough delay, get going and explore the single dwarven hut along the path in the north.][2, If your findings are correct, there's nothing around there that even remotely suggests an ancient burial ground. It's unfortunate, but there's one more spot you need to check before we give up all hope. Go ahead and explore the large rock tower on goblin isle. Be careful, if there is a burial ground, there's no telling what kind of creatures lurk nearby.][3, It's unfortunate that you weren't able to find any remnants at all. Perhaps there will be more to find next time. In the meantime, you need to report your findings, so speak with Tarerd Gahar. That is all.]

tasks.title: Tour of the Castle
tasks.description: [1,Very Quickly, you need to speak with Averna Eisley to let them know that you're the Red Beetle. Your contact will know what it means.][2,Your contact was impressed that you kept your wits about you and didn't give away your cover. Now, as to why you're here. Your code name is Red Beetle and you've been assigned to explore the entrance to the graveyard. This is a very dangerous place where reports suggest there is a rebellion forming. You must go there and determine whether or not this is true.][3,It looks like the insurgents are forming quickly, Red Beetle. It's up to you to take the raven to the raven's nest and kill 10 pledge familiars. Only after that will you be able to retire from this life of subterfuge. Good luck.][4,You were almost discovered, and that's a quick way to foil the operation -- or worse yet -- get yourself killed. However, you were able to secure the area and get rid of the rebels. Find and speak with Brynn Tinkerton, codenamed Black Bixie, to update your progress. After that, your services will no longer be needed.]

tasks.title: Beetles of the Estate
tasks.description: [1,Many ancient artifacts collected from the Estate of Unrest have been damaged before they could be retrieved. Go speak with Symperbell Moor and let her know that you are willing to help to identify the cause of the damage.][2,Follow Symperbell's instructions and explore the rear entrance of Unrest Manor.][3,She was right! The beetles are getting in through the back. Kill 10 beetles to help in preserving the artifacts.][4,Truly, you have shown the courage that many others have not. Speak with Feriella Vorana to receive acknowledgement and thanks for your part in preserving ancient artifacts for future generations.]

tasks.title: Arachnida
tasks.description:
[1,2, The kobolds are raising the Gloomfang Spiders to guard these mines. Queen Gloomfang's latest brood recently tore free from their cocoons and now the southern caves are crawling with giant spider. Get in there and clear out those blasted things!]
[3, Great work! Speak with Guard Rahtiz to receive your reward.]

tasks.title: Clearing the Vermin Nests
tasks.description:
[1,2,3, The vermin infesting these tunnels threaten our scarce provisions. If you want to help our revolt, start by clearing the tunnel beyond of rats and bats. Speak with Vahlara when you've finished your hunt and she will reward you with a pair of stitched leggings. They're not much, but they're all we can spare right now. (Hint: You may also speak with Wijdan in the slave revolt camp after you finish this mission. He's interested in buying any rat fur you've acquired.)]
[4, Excellent work! Speak with Vahlara to receive your reward.]

tasks.title: Rebellion Reloaded
tasks.description: [1, The kobolds will be charging down this passage here. I'll only have time to fire a few arrows before they close to melee. Venture into the tunnels beyond and bring me one more arrow, it might just save my life. The kobolds typically leave extras ammunition in the barrels throughout the mines. Break a few of them open and you'll likely find some arrows we can use. (Hint: To open the barrels you can destroy and then loot the arrows from the wreckage.) ]

tasks.title: The Hungry Halfling
tasks.description: [1,2,3,4, Thank you so much. Here is the book, now see what sort of things you can come up with.][5,What a tradeskiller you must be! Why don't you go back and speak with Mippie Diggs?]

tasks.title: Goblin Treachery
tasks.description: [1,Assist Revolt Scout Kaikachi. Slay Rookfynn and ten of his goblin minions. You should try looking around Dig Site One.][2,Excellent work! Return to Revolt Scout Kaikachi and tell him about your victory!]

tasks.title: Basic Training
tasks.description: [1,Hail the various members of the Gloomingdeep slave revolt to learn more about the game.]

tasks.title: Speak with Guard Rahtiz
tasks.description: [1,Talk to Guard Rahtiz and see where you are needed.]

tasks.title: The Battle of Gloomingdeep
tasks.description: [1,2,3,4, Can you hear the sounds of combat echoing through these tunnels? That's the sound of war! Gather a group of comrades and spearhead an attack into the kobold territory. I will reward your bravery in kind, soldier.][5, Now report back your success!]

tasks.title: Spider Caves
tasks.description:
[1, Vahlara needs as much Gloomingdeep silk as she can get her hands on. She's in special need of Gloomingdeep cocoon silk which has a thicker weave yet remains supple enough to make bandages.

Sneak into the kobolds' spider hatchery to the south and harvest some Gloomingdeep cocoon silk from the spiderling cocoons.

(Hint: Even though the cocoon clusters are objects and not NPCs, you can still attack, destroy and loot them normally.)][2,Excellent work! Now you must deliver the cocoon silk to Vahlara.]

tasks.title: Spider Tamer Gugan
tasks.description:
[1, The Gloomingdeep Spider Tamer is able to brew anti-venom from a rare flower that grows in Gloomingdeep.

If we had this flower, we may be able to use it to save the lives of our comrades. ][2, The Gloomingdeep Spider Tamer is able to brew anti-venom from a rare flower that grows in Gloomingdeep.

If we had this flower, we may be able to use it to save the lives of our comrades.]

tasks.title: Freedom's Stand (Group)
tasks.description: [1, Now that you've proven your combat prowess, I ask that you find Overlord Gnikan and kill him. He runs the entire mining operation here in Gloomingdeep. Without his leadership, the kobold forces will soon scramble and flee. I'm sending you deep behind enemy lines for this one, soldier. Remember your training and you will make it back alive!][2, Report your success to Guard Hobart.]

tasks.title: Sabotage
tasks.description:
[1, Da kobolds waz foolish enough ta teach us ta make blasting powder fer op'nin' new mine tunnels. Here, take dis makeshift lantern bomb and place it on the kobolds' siege supplies. Da supplies are in a giant crate just outside o' Fort Gloomingdeep. Once you set da bomb, get out of dere fast! Heh, heh, it's gonna blow big, ya?

(Hint: To set the bomb, left click on the item in your inventory to join it to your mouse cursor. Then move the lantern bomb over the crate, left click again, and press the 'Give' button)]

tasks.title: Scouting Gloomingdeep
tasks.description: [1, Da revolt is pinned down defending dis position. We needs ya ta explore the rest o' da mines and sees where the kobolds 'ave dug in so we can plan our counter attack. Here are some directions fer find da kobold fortress'.][2, Da revolt is pinned down defending dis position. We needs ya ta explore the rest o' da mines and sees where the kobolds 'ave dug in so we can plan our counter attack. Here are some directions fer find da kobold fortress'.][3, Da revolt is pinned down defending dis position. We needs ya ta explore the rest o' da mines and sees where the kobolds 'ave dug in so we can plan our counter attack. Here are some directions fer find da kobold fortress'.][4, Da revolt is pinned down defending dis position. We needs ya ta explore the rest o' da mines and sees where the kobolds 'ave dug in so we can plan our counter attack. Here are some directions fer find da kobold fortress'.][5, Report back what you have found.]

tasks.title: Arachnophobia (Group)
tasks.description:
[1, Queen Gloomfang spawns dozens of eggs every day. She must be stopped before the kobolds can train and raise any more spiderlings. You will recognize her perch by the thick stench of poison and decay.

Once you destroy her, Hobart can use an extract from her chitin to brew you a protective potion.][2, Queen Gloomfang spawns dozens of eggs every day. She must be stopped before the kobolds can train and raise any more spiderlings. You will recognize her perch by the thick stench of poison and decay.

Once you destroy her, Hobart can use an extract from her chitin to brew you a protective potion.]

tasks.title: Kobold Leadership
tasks.description: [1, The kobolds are too well organized. We need brave warriors to sneak behind enemy lines and take out the Gloomingdeep leaders. Only then can we begin to fight our way out of there.]

tasks.title: Pit Fiend (Group)
tasks.description: [1, Before the revolt broke out, the kobolds awoke something terrible deep in the mines. The unearthed creature, whatever it is, killed many kobolds and slaves alike. Gather a group of comrades and put an end to the earth daemon lurking near the bottom of the central mining pit.]

tasks.title: Flutterwing's Dilemma
tasks.description: [1,Help Flutterwing find his missing siblings!][2,Good work! Now return the egg to Flutterwing.]

tasks.title: Desert Crawl
tasks.description: [1,2,3,4,5,Head to North Ro and prove your worth.][6,Good work! Now return to Castlen Drewe to claim your reward.]

tasks.title: Elusive Wisps (Old Nektulos)
tasks.description: [1,Kill Greater Wisps in Nektulos Forest][2,Explore the Wizard platform][3,Explore the area near Lavastorm][4,Speak with Castlen Drewe in the Plane of Knowledge]

tasks.title: Haunted Butcherblock
tasks.description: [1,Do stuff in Butcherblock]

tasks.title: Protecting the High Pass
tasks.description: [1,Head to the entrance to Highpass Hold.][2,3,Here they come! You must defend the pass!!][4,Excellent work! You should go back and speak with Caslten Drewe about this.]

tasks.title: Scouting Blackburrow
tasks.description: [1,Scouts on patrol in the Qeynos Hills have been reporting an increase in aggressive gnoll activity. It seems that an unusual number of guardsmen have been seen roving through Blackburrow, as if they are gearing up for some sort of attack. Take the portal to Qeynos and venture to Blackburrow to investigate.][2,Find a way to thin the ranks of guardsmen. If they are planning something, we will need them to be as weakened as possible.][3,Check passages leading out into Everfrost for any further clues to the objectives of the gnolls. If they are heading into Halas, we may have time to warn them.][4,It seems that our scouts managed to alert us before the gnolls were fully prepared. Excellent work! Return to Castlen Drewe in the Plane of Knowledge.]

tasks.title: The Frozen Crystal
tasks.description:
[1,Buried in the frigid peaks of Everfrost lies a dangerous place by the name of Permafrost Keep. It is tended by all manner of goblins that seem to thrive despite the chilling temperatures. A jeweler by the name of Audri Deepfacet claims to have found a special crystal there. No one has been able to verify her story, and she failed to bring back a sample. We believe that it may have some special power, providing it exists of course.

Travel to Everfrost and find the secret back entrance to Permafrost Keep. The front way is guarded by vast ice giants and may be impassible.][2,3,Slay any goblins that get in your way, and find the Permafrost Crystal!][4,Bring the crystal to Audri Deepfacet in the Plane of Knowledge.]

tasks.title: Within the Warrens
tasks.description: [1,Head to The Warrens on Odus and explore the bridge to Prince Bragnar][2,Excellent! Go back and speak with Castlen Drewe.]
